## Observation datasets

### zinc\_dewaele\_2008\_table2\_compression

- **Description:** All 43 Zn pressure-volume observations transcribed from Dewaele et al. (2008), Table II.
- **Kind:** pressure\_volume
- **Reference:**
    - **Authors:** Dewaele; Torrent; Loubeyre; Mezouar
    - **Year:** 2008
    - **Title:** Compression curves of transition metals in the Mbar range: Experiments and projector augmented-wave calculations
    - **Source:** Physical Review B
    - **DOI:** 10.1103/PhysRevB.78.104102
- **Source location:** Table II
- **Associated EOS records:** zinc\_hcp\_dewaele\_2019\_mao\_vinet; zinc\_hcp\_dewaele\_2019\_dor\_vinet
- **Notes:** The table supplies Mao-scale pressure and atomic volume. The dedicated Dewaele (2019) audit converts between its two ruby scales explicitly.
